description: This file contains declarations related to symbolizing combined traceback objects for profiling, including functions for converting tracebacks into Python objects and JSON format, along with memory management functions for traceback frames.

methods.name: py_symbolize
methods.description: Converts a batch of captured traceback objects into a list of Python objects for easy consumption.

methods.name: json_symbolize
methods.description: Converts a batch of captured traceback objects into JSON format for use in Python.

methods.name: freeDeadCapturedTracebackFrames
methods.description: Frees any pending stale traceback frames, requires the Python GIL to be held.

methods.name: installCapturedTracebackPython
methods.description: Installs the Python bindings for captured traceback functionality.
